title: Themes
hint: All your themes: search, filter, create and publish.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, slug or description…
emptyText: Create a theme from scratch or import your hand-made CSS files.
shadowedNote: The hand-made file {file} on the server takes precedence: nginx serves that file instead of this theme. Move or remove it on the server; after that the same URL serves the theme.
exportCssNeedsLive: No live version yet: publish first, or export the bundle.
copyFailed: Could not copy. The URL is {url}
deleteText: {file} returns 404 afterwards. You can restore the theme via the status filter “Deleted”.
purgeText: The theme and all its versions disappear for good. This cannot be undone.
newDescription: The slug becomes the public URL /<slug>.css.
paletteHint: Tokens become --ct-* variables in front of your CSS.
slugHintAuto: Follows the name until you change it.
slugTooShort: A slug has at least 2 characters.
slugTooLong: A slug has at most 64 characters.
slugFormat: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; start and end with a letter or digit.
start_copyHint: The draft of an existing theme.
duplicateDescription: The draft and metadata are copied, the version history is not. The copy is not live yet.
errorNetwork: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errorServer: The server reported an error. Try again later.
errorSlugConflict: This slug is already in use.
errorStateConflict: This is not possible in the current state.
errorPrecondition: Someone else changed this theme in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errorCsrf: Refused: changes can only be made from the dashboard itself, not from another page.
errorProxyRequired: Refused: changes are only accepted through Nginx Proxy Manager (TRUSTED_PROXIES). Open the dashboard through your domain.
